nodes.title: About Size
widgets_values:
Width & height settings must be divisible by 32 + 1. 
Frame count must be divisible by 8 + 1. 


Running with invalid parameters **will not cause errors**. Instead, the flow will silently choose the closest valid parameters. 

By default, we are using 720p resolution. You can try 1920*1088 if you have a powerful GPU.

## LTX-2 Prompting Tips

1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Visual Details**: Describe all visual details you want to appear in the video  
3. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene

## Report LTX-2 Issues
To report any issues when running this workflow, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)

# MARKDKBERRY.COM

## IMPORTANT CAVEAT: If you are on 12GB VRAM and 32 gb system ram you will get OOMs at the VAE decoder. You therefore need to set your comfyui to allow for pushing through ooms. I do that with my switches:

`--lowvram --disable-smart-memory --disable-pinned-memory`

## ABOUT THIS WORKFLOW

This workflow works very well. high detail at 1080p and the best I found so far (not perfect but damn good).

You need a high quality first image from the video as a reference and it will use it to inform the result. 

**on my 3060 I get 1080p 24 fps, 241 frames in < 18 minutes.** I do hit ooms on the VAE and push through which means I cant use memory cleaners to drop models as it forces a restart at that point. I still managed to use GPU on clip but ideal would be to use their API. The ram (32 system ram) overloads first, I think.

## INFO:

Inbound I use 480 long edge setting and use x2 upscalers, you can change that if you like but it will be rubbish results lower inbound ( e.g. 320). I havent fiddled with it yet to improve speeds or results.

Also dont try and go over 241 frames. When I did and it ooms so not sure how I will deal with extended shots. I tried splitting it, and got new people applied even using the same ref image. I think you need to build a new ref image for the new start frame point to inform it properly. It works well still, just wrong people (if camera moved, which it had).


I need to get the time down if I  can but just being able to do this from 480 long edge means the inbound can be done quicker in the first place and this details it up. Best results I have seen so far from LTX-2 by far coming out of this.
give me a good video prompt for LTX model.

NOTE: I am still not using this yet.

NOTE: dont use this unless you have original LTX checkpoint model. I dont. I'll keep it in but disabled until I confirm this is somehow useable on my setup.

----


This needs a non GGUF model to work at this time. It also needs the model to be in the checkpoint folder. (I found fp4 model works from Kijai but havent tested quality against my Q4 GGUF) - Mark, Feb 2026.

# LTX API SECTION:

This is for using LTX API for the Gemma which at the current time is offered free to the community. It should save on ram use. So definitely worth it for LowVRAM guys.

get and set from https://console.ltx.video

# INSTALL PRIVATE KEY CUSTOM NODE: 

I installed this one https://github.com/wtesler/ComfyUI-EnvVariable

Then add something this to your comfyui start up bat file:

REM Set your API key as an environment variable
set LTX_API_KEY=xxxxxxxxx

REM use this if you need to see it getting set: 
echo LTX_API_KEY=%LTX_API_KEY%

this is gimmicky not sure it even works, but supposed to help create NSFW prompt not sure LTX will accept it anyway without a abliterated clip to go with it. It also doenst work from image without a VL LLM, and is probably faster using other methods.

# READ ME FIRST

**MAJOR CHANGE IN MY APPROACH WITH LTX-2.3 vrs LTX-2**:

March 2026. LTX 2.3 I find using audio in often doesnt work for lipsync and I dont know why. But a new approach works just as well.

- instead of creating the audio with Vibe Voice and using it here, I use timings in the prompt like below and let the LTX-2.3 model make the audio. LTX-2.3 has much better audio and timing capabilities, and doing this allows it to adapt the faces to what it wants rather than fighting it with forcing the audio-in. I leave this section here bypassed as it might be of use sometimes, but will be using prompt timings then swapping the dialogue out later. This "over-dubbing of sound" is fairly normal practise anyway in movies these days. Prompt example using timings:
</br>
	```
	a man with curly blond medium length hair is sat in a parked car.
	0-4 seconds he asks, "what are you two wandering about dressed like that for in this weather?"
	4-6 seconds he says, "You'll catch your death of cold."
	8-9 seconds he asks, "Can I give you a lift?"
	perfect natural lipsync and correct pronunciation.
	```
</br>

# BREAKING CHANGES - FEB 2026

## **NOTE: RECENT CHANGES IN COMFYUI WILL SOON BREAK THE WAY MODELS ARE LOADED IN LTX.**

This is the patch they added back in that temporarily resolves it

[https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/12605](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/12605 ) 

 but they plan to remove it at some point in the future. This is why I have changed the layout here to accommodate that when it comes.

1. **I (hopefully mistakenly) took the change to imply that GGUFs will no longer work** (after the patch is removed). Kijai has suggested this is wrong and the only impact will be nodes not the models themselves. But because there was some concern that ["missing weights" in GGUFs will mean GGUFs break](https://www.reddit.com/r/comfyui/comments/1rdvuil/comment/o78gpul/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web3x&utm_name=web3xcss&utm_term=1&utm_content=share_button) I am erring on the side of caution and downloaded a working non-GGUF model. The FP4 from Kijais hugging face repo. (See below section)

## THE NEW NODE LAYOUT

It was confusing to figure out. Even though some seemed to find it easy.

### Step 1: 

**You need to update KJ nodes to after 25th Feb 2026**

- **make sure the "extra_model_name" in GGUFLoaderKJ can find the embeddings connector.** It looks for "connector" in file names of the "text_encoders" folder which is where it likely is currently in your setup. This will also pick up in the "Diffusion Model Selector" node.
</br>
- **put the FP4 model or whatever non-GGUF model you want to use in the "diffusion_models" folder** and you can then add it to diffusion model loader. 

### Step 2:

- **understanding why we dont do anything with current embeddings connector** - the weird thing is that even though we now have to add the embeddings connector in to the GGUF loader and the Diffusion Model Selector moving forward (when they remove the temp patch), we still currently need the old embeddings DualClip Loader node left in place and plugged in. For now. I have the below info quoted from discussion on with with Kijai:

> "if you get errors make sure you are STILL ALSO using the dual clip loader for gemma and embeddings. because you do need to as there's the text projector layer in the file too...yeah that's extra annoying. it won't use memory though, it just loads that one layer... just don't change anything else besides the model loader, keep the dualclip like it used to be"

***NOTE: I am guessing the above will change at some point too, but for now its how it is - Mark, 26th Feb 2026.***



## THE FP4 MODEL

[https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTXV2_comfy/tree/main/diffusion_models](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTXV2_comfy/tree/main/diffusion_models)

I understand this needs pytorch 2.10 and CUDA 13.0 to work but it is running on my pytorch 2.7 with CUDA 12.8 just it needs tweaks in the lora settings. (I'll put those in their own box.) 

Its also a bit faster than the GGUF Q4 model and runs without issue on my 3060 RTX (12GB VRAM) with 32 GB system ram.
chunk may not be needed if dynamic vram working and it all fits in, else use it but dont do more than 2 is recommendation - March 2026

subtitles, text, blurry, low quality, still frame, frames, watermark, overlay, titles, houses, buildings, cars, roads, turn left, turn right, move backwards, men standing, men walking, men getting up from the campfire, trees moving, branches moving,

With ltx-2.3 not seeing need for detailer or camera control any longer (LTX 2). 

also the distill lora can use 384 but it is 7GB and the Kijai (see his hugging face) one listed is only 2.5GB but about as good. setting seems to be 0.4 to 0.6 I left it on 0.6. Keep checking his HF repo for the latest.

I am now using VBVR set around 0.4 to 0.7 which is a reasoning lora and seems to help with v2v physics and adherance to the video in most cases.

Amateur Hour is a trial lora that isnt XXX as it suggests, but is actually supposed to be better for face structure. I am using it at 0.4 strength but not sure if its helping. I tried 1.0 and it seemed to change the character but it might have been seed.

I am still fighting bad eyes in this workflow but it is vastly improved with new Sampler in between the upscalers. 

- Mark, April 2026.

# CHANGES

- Removed AV from first sampler left it in 2nd, to test and hopefully save time (2 mins on 10). Uncertain if lipsync/audio needs to be driven through twice would it make it better? tbd. - Mark, April 2026.

---

2nd STAGE SAMPLER TESTS ON FACE ISSUES:

(note cfg_pp does not play well with ggufs)

conclusion: going with euler_ancestral as first choice and er_sde if it has a problem.

---

- er_sde - fast and seems best yet for faces and eyes

- euler_ancestral on a par with er_sde and done in 14 mins same, but I feel like er_sde may be slightly better. This seems to be one of the most recommended for LTX.

- lcm - fast but messy
- euler - slow but better than lcm only just (at cost of 2 mins)

- res_2s wouldnt even run just sat there for ages so gave up.

overcast day in a pine forest clearing in England in summer in the 1600s. camera tracks slowly backward from three men. the man on the left puts his flintlock pistol away, and then the three men talk with each other while remaining seated at the campfire.

# QUALITY TESTING 26th APRIL 2026:

*The workflow now takes 18 mins generally and this is due mostly to the euler in 1st sampler (also at 25 fps in testing), set it back to lcm (and/or 24fps) and it will be a lot quicker but quality will drop slightly out of the 1st sampler.*

## CHANGES MADE AS A RESULT OF THE TESTS:

- **increase steps (sigmas) in first upsampler** - improved so keeping it

- **added ClownSchedule node to 1st sampler for better control of linear_quadratic sigma setups** if I ever decide to increase above 9 (to 20,30 or 40) for testing its the best approach. Its exactly like having manual sigmas set so using it.

- **Use euler_ancestral in 1st sampler** if it has issues switch back to LCM or maybe euler but euler seemed to take longer than euler_ancestral in tests. *(note: it does increase time to as much as 25 mins to complete but might have been a bad mem run)*.

- **trialling 25fps as default moving forward** also need to test 35fps for motion at some point.

- **Running the final result (USDU) through again vastly improved everything** this means better quality input is making a difference. 

---

## TEST 0: split lora for distilled to str 0.25 goes to 1st sampler and 0.6 goes to 2nd sampler.

***(NOTE: this seems to be causing massive slow down on 2nd sampler +20 mins just on that sampler in some cases so reverted back to 1 sampler and set it to 0.5 instead of 0.6, will have to revisit method of applying it. There is a delay due to euler use in 1st sampler but that is expected.)*** 

- **add 2nd lora for distilled lora, setting 1st upsampler to 0.25 strength**, and 2nd to 0.6 str. This required 2 lora loading nodes and putting them at the end of the model chain instead of the previous 1 lora for distilled in the lora section. (under test).

## TEST 1:

The below pushed it up from 14 mins to 18 mins (mostly euler switch I think), 

**RESULTS** did show some structural improvements, background stayed still, was good until the faces moved back some distance, but also it still lost consistency of faces. 

- increase from 24fps to 25 fps

- change first sampler from lcm to euler

- test LTXV Enhance A Video KJ node set to weight 0.001 (place it between LTXV concat and guider on each upsampler step) (MBEDIT: a later KB search suggested: *"Summary: If you are looking for finer detail and are willing to accept a 30% increase in render time, the node is a viable experimental tool. However, its tendency to change the overall output means it should be used carefully, starting with a lower strength (around 2.0, some push it to 8.0)"*)

- sigmas to try (confirm i might already be using):
  + 1st sampler is same. 
  + 2nd suggested this: `0.909375, 0.725, 0.421875, 0.0` (my current settings were this: `0.85, 0.7250, 0.4219, 0.0`)

---

## TEST 2: lcm again in 1st sampler but with other changes still in place

I am going to switch back to LCM on first upsampler try to regain speed and find out if anything else helped or if it was mostly that. 
  + **RESULTS:** took 17 mins and the quality was degraded and some of the background was moving about again. 25fps is probably adding the time but its only 241 frames due to short video.

---

## TEST 3: reducing str of distill lora in 1st sampler to 0.25 (was 0.6)

seems that removing distilled lora or reducing it to 0.25 for first pass is another trick but it might need 30 steps. (need to test this is first wf too) to test this I need to get output from first upsampler and get that looking good before going to final upsampler.

- getting test output from previous settings of the 1st sampler upscaling result in mp4 format to look at 

- reducing distill lora from 0.6 to 0.25 and adding export video to the first upsampler.
  + **RESULT** first impression reducing it let to less movement from the characters but need to test with full sigmas in place... 

- first with lcm and 0.25 in the distill lora. 1st sampler output only. 9 steps in sigmas. 25fps. 241 frames (233 when 24fps)
  + **RESULT** definitely detail is crisper than 0.6.

## TEST 4: test res_2s in 1st sampler

- testing res_2s instead of lcm on first sampler. (0.25 in the distill lora. 1st sampler output only. 9 steps in sigmas. 25fps. 241 frames (233 when 24fps) ).
  + **RESULTS** (lcm is 415 seconds at this stage). res_2s was 35 mins and surprisingly poor results, the eyes were no good from start, and face soon blemanged, but background was stunning. NOTE: should have done half sigmas for that anyway but good to know its not that much better. This does suggest targetting the original inbound video to improve that. Going to test it shortly and come back. First test Euler vrs LCM.

## TEST 5: euler types in 1st sampler. 0.25 str distill lora. 9 steps sigmas.

- **euler in the 1st sampler**. (0.25 in the distill lora. 1st sampler output only. 9 steps in sigmas. 25fps. 241 frames (233 when 24fps) )   + **RESULT** 500 seconds. (LCM was 415) result not great as I had hoped. 

- **euler_ancestral in the 1st sampler**. (same all else)
  + **RESULT**: took 447 secs and eyes seemed slightly better so could be the best so far vrs time. tbd. the entire thing had a slightly darker look I thought. might stick to it or switch to Euler for further tests and LCM if need it slightly quicker.</br>

- **euler_ancestral_cfg_pp in the 1st sampler**.
  + **RESULTS**: wouldnt get started so cancelled it. gonna take too long.

## TEST 6: disable distill lora for 1st sampler push to 20 steps.

- disable the distill lora but might need to push steps up so adding in a "ClownScheduler" node for better sigma management with linear_quadratic (which is what the manual sigmas are anyway). NOTE: recommends are 20 , 30, or 40 without but that will suck timewise. test with LCM.
  + **RESULT**: took 13 mins. looked better for first frames then went into that misty disillation look so it needs more steps or the distill back in. but I have some new information on approach I need to test next which includes this but is better suited to applying it to the original wf creating the 480 x 201 and bumping it to double that in the i2v stage before this then half it going into this and do it all again. but for now test here.

## TEST 7: ClownSampler in 1st sampler

taken from this conversation *"Two pass. full dev model. Distil lora only on the upscale pass. Out of the box, just switched the sampler to RES4LYF euler with bongmath. I'm not using clownsharksampler, just switching the sampler. Connect "ClownSampler" node to the Samplercustomadvanced  The workflow is somewhere in the comments. first you generate the low resolution "base" video and then upscale it in second pass with distill lora.  You use the distilled lora not in the first stage 30 step generation, but during the second upscale pass, 3 steps."*

- first try the ClownSampler with the distilled lora in, set to 0.25 str, and 9 steps sigma (25fps, 241 frames) as initial test before disabling lora and trying 30 steps as prescribed. (going to 960 x whatever it is)
  + **RESULT**: took 20 mins and I honestly did not see the improvement at all. DONT DO THIS WITHOUT DISTILLED, it took too long. try it on previous workflow for first i2v though with res_2s and see what it does.
